title: Important Updates for the Binance P2P Block Zone in LATAM
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services mentioned here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To strengthen the security, liquidity, and operational quality of the Binance P2P ecosystem, and to raise the professional standards of merchants holding advanced badges, we share the following updates for merchants with  BLOCK  and  SHIELD  badges. 1. Important Clarification on Security Deposits The security deposits for each badge are  additional  to the basic deposit required to maintain the  Verified Merchant  badge, and will accumulate based on the active badges held by each merchant. Basic Verified Merchant deposit by country: Dominican Republic:  1,000 USDT Venezuela:  800 USDT Mexico, Colombia, Peru, Argentina:  500 USDT Bolivia:  300 USDT Brazil, Chile, Ecuador:  200 USDT Rest of LATAM:  100 USDT Total deposit calculation examples (Venezuela): Verified Merchant with VE KYC/KYB +  BLOCK :  	 800 USDT (VE basic) + 5,000 USDT (BLOCK) = 5,800 USDT total Verified Merchant with VE KYC/KYB +  BLOCK  +  PRO :  800 + 5,000 + 1,000 = 6,800 USDT total Verified Merchant with VE KYC/KYB +  SHIELD :  800 + 10,000 = 10,800 USDT total Verified Merchant with VE KYC/KYB +  BLOCK + PRO + SHIELD :  800 + 5,000 + 1,000 + 10,000 = 16,800 USDT total Deposits are  cumulative  and must remain available in the Funding account associated with the corresponding KYC/KYB. 2. BLOCK badge deposit update for Venezuela For verified merchants with  Venezuelan KYC or KYB (VE)  applying for or maintaining the  BLOCK  badge, the additional security deposit will increase from  2,500 USDT to 5,000 USDT . This means the  total  deposit required for a Venezuelan BLOCK merchant will be  5,800 USDT total , corresponding to  800 USDT (VE basic) + 5,000 USDT (BLOCK) . For the  rest of LATAM , the additional BLOCK badge deposit remains at  2,500 USDT , added to the basic deposit applicable by country. BLOCK calculation examples (other countries): MX + BLOCK:  500 + 2,500 = 3,000 USDT CO + BLOCK + PRO:  500 + 2,500 + 1,000 = 4,000 USDT BO + BLOCK:  300 + 2,500 = 2,800 USDT 3. Block Zone and Normal Zone Limit Updates in LATAM The  Block Zone  limits will be recalibrated by market to reflect the local operational reality of each currency. Additionally, the  Normal Zone upper limit  will be aligned with the  Block Zone lower limit  in each market, eliminating any gap between zones. Effective:  2026-06-01 New limits by market  (the  Block Zone Lower Limit  matches the  Normal Zone Upper Limit ): Venezuela (VES): Bs.D 36,450,000 Bolivia (BOB): Bs. 300,000 Brazil (BRL): R$ 154,500 Mexico (MXN): MX$ 520,200 Argentina (ARS): $ 29,680,000 Chile (CLP): $ 18,070,000 Colombia (COP): $ 72,700,000 Peru (PEN): S/ 68,800 Paraguay (PYG): ₲ 122,000,000 Uruguay (UYU): $U 766,400 Ads that do not meet the new minimum amount may be  closed  automatically. We recommend reviewing and updating your ads before the effective date to avoid disruption in your operation. 4. SHIELD badge Deposit Update The additional security deposit required for the  SHIELD  badge will increase to  10,000 USDT . This deposit is also  additional  to the basic Verified Merchant deposit and to any other deposit associated with active badges (BLOCK, PRO, etc.). Examples: VE + SHIELD:  800 + 10,000 = 10,800 USDT MX + SHIELD + PRO:  500 + 10,000 + 1,000 = 11,500 USDT CO + BLOCK + SHIELD:  	 500 + 2,500 + 10,000 = 13,000 USDT 5. Mandatory Requirements to Retain Badges The security deposit increase will be  mandatory  for all  Venezuelan BLOCK merchants  and merchants holding the  SHIELD  badge. Additionally, the following operational requirements must be met: BLOCK badge:  At least  one (1) successful transaction as Maker  in the Block Zone per month. SHIELD badge:  Maintain a trading volume above  120 BTC per month . Failure to meet these requirements may result in loss of the corresponding badge. 6. Compliance Deadline The deadline to increase the security deposit and meet the transaction/volume requirements is  2026-06-15 We recommend completing adjustments in advance to avoid the risk of badge loss. How to increase the security deposit:  Perform a  manual top up  from the  Merchant Portal , in the profile section, following the official instructions  here .  7. Important Notice on Wash Trading The P2P transaction required in the  Block Zone   cannot  be carried out with a counterparty where the funds subsequently return to the original account. This will be considered  wash trading  and may result in penalties, including: Loss of the BLOCK badge and other active badges. Restrictions or suspension of P2P functionalities. Additional actions by the Risk Department in accordance with internal policies. We request that transactions be conducted with legitimate counterparties and under transparent commercial practices, in accordance with the professional standards expected of a BLOCK or SHIELD merchant. We appreciate your collaboration and commitment to maintaining a safer, more professional, and more reliable P2P ecosystem. We remain available for inquiries through the official support channels. Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.  Thank you for your support!
